newsitem.title: UK: Inspirations winter passenger volumes up.
newsitem.headline: Inspirations winter passenger volumes up.

text.p: British tour operator Inspirations Plc said on Friday that winter passenger volumes have increased by 12 percent and that average prices obtained are also significantly higher than last season.

Inspirations chairman Jim Harris told the company's annual general meeting that passenger volumes for this summer are down in absolute terms as the company has reduced capacity for the summer period by around 20 percent.
However, he noted that the percentage of the programme sold is considerably higher than at the same time last year.
In November, the company warned shareholders that it expected results for the year ended September 30, 1996 would be "substantially" below market expectations.
By 0943 GMT, shares in the company had risen five pence to stand at 81p.
